text.circuit.part.trace.name: Lacquered conductor
text.circuit.part.trace.description: An insulated iron trace for a surface or buried circuit run.
text.circuit.part.via.name: Insulated via
text.circuit.part.via.description: A sleeved vertical joint between a floor trace and its buried layer.
text.circuit.part.rack.name: Galvanic rack
text.circuit.part.rack.description: Holds one galvanic cell and sends a timed electrical pulse.
text.circuit.part.cell.name: Galvanic cell
text.circuit.part.cell.description: An iron-carbon and brine pulse cell for the rack.
text.circuit.part.switch.name: Knife switch
text.circuit.part.switch.description: A hand-operated contact that passes pulses only when closed.
text.circuit.part.lamp.name: Shielded arc lamp
text.circuit.part.lamp.description: A pulse-lit lamp that widens nearby sight while charged.
text.circuit.part.gate.name: Latch gate
text.circuit.part.gate.description: Blocks movement until a pulse releases its latch briefly.
text.circuit.part.drain.name: Sump pump
text.circuit.part.drain.description: A pulsed pump that drains nearby standing water and temporary floods.
text.circuit.part.sensor.name: Field sensor
text.circuit.part.sensor.description: Passes pulses only while its chosen condition detects mass, water, or a nearby threat.
text.circuit.part.relay.name: One-way relay
text.circuit.part.relay.description: Receives a pulse from behind and sends it only toward its facing.
text.circuit.part.counter.name: Counted relay
text.circuit.part.counter.description: Passes one pulse after a chosen number of received pulses.
text.circuit.part.piston.name: Crank piston
text.circuit.part.piston.description: A directional actuator that pushes up to three movable crates; a sticky setting pulls one back.
text.circuit.part.crate.name: Movable freight crate
text.circuit.part.crate.description: A physical blocking crate that a powered piston can shift and a buried sensor can weigh.
